shared_elements: low-relief figures arranged along a horizontal band
justification: Both surfaces show profile quadrupeds and at least one humanoid figure carved in low relief along horizontal registers, but that is the extent of the correspondence and it is of the most generic kind. A presents isolated, schematic, non-interacting creatures (canid, birds, snake-like form, a zigzag/net band) stacked in registers, while B is a single unified naturalistic narrative in which an archer in a wheeled vehicle drawn by harnessed animals confronts a rearing lion, with musculature, harness and garment detail wholly absent in A.
